variantMapping.reason: All 147 applicable iOS base variants resolve to exact public figmaNodeID without fallback; raw property values are preserved. All ten set/instance properties mapped, including independent Large/Medium and Small swaps. Source demo frame widths recorded explicitly; consumer instance geometry must be read separately. The 147 copyable examples compile and render in the 285-example QA test. This accepts API mapping only.

specification.reason: Available functional Button guide text and all 26 Styles rows read; applicable construction/content/radius/masking/editorial diagrams reviewed, clipped 11096:17944 explicitly excluded. Fresh 147 iOS IDs/properties/frames unchanged. Linked pixel Sensitive full construction read; new particle Sensitive reference remains partial. Pixel masking implemented and tested through the shared Sensitive runtime on 2026-10-13. Acceptance remains pending for exact legacy nested Loader/Skeleton motion and full visual/typography verification. Corner-case and Foundations Shadow contexts reread; source stops/Blur/Y-axis and Night removal recorded before the targeted checks and shadow change. Button Skeleton instance-to-main inheritance and both source reactions read and confirmed; the shared pulse is now reused. Old nested Loader timing remains UNVERIFIED.

visual.reason: 270 native @3x renders cover 135 non-glass variants in Day/Night, frame sizes verified; eight default runtime boards remain RGBA-identical. Token bindings and independent customization checked. These are runtime/regression evidence only: full Figma PNG pairs for all 147, glass backdrop, shadow, fade and typography acceptance remain pending. On 2026-10-13 the three skeleton radius contours were corrected to source values 16/12/100. Six Day/Night @3x renders were recaptured at exact source widths/heights and a focused iOS Simulator pixel test plus catalog build passed; this is a local regression fix, not complete Figma visual acceptance. On 2026-10-13 native overflow alpha matches the 85.065% source fade profile in 18 cases; literal guide illustration remains visually unresolved because its shortened text fits the native font. Floating blur conversion corrected; three normal Day full-effect source pairs improve by 77–78%, three Night renders pixel-identical. All 12 Floating variants regenerated in both themes; remaining states are runtime evidence, not full source visual acceptance. Twelve fresh Primary Day source pairs measured; MAE 0.208–3.899/255, typography still pending. Skeleton now has three fresh Day pairs with MAE 0.005629–0.040936/255 and six native size/theme renders. Edge rasterization differs from former fill and is reported explicitly; Night source pairing and full matrix remain pending.

interaction.reason: Existing seven Button UI checks plus final separate consumer test remain historical evidence. New actual catalog UI test passed: Medium Fill/Hug selection, real action, loading retains intrinsic width and Fill restoration. Additional custom pressed/disabled behavior and all specification content combinations remain pending; this test is not VoiceOver verification. 2026-10-13: masked/unmasked label and preserved Button/link/whole-control actions verified in live catalog and independent consumer; this does not accept all147 Button combinations. Live Skeleton action suppression and stable frame verified for all three sizes in Day/Night after inherited pulse was connected.

This is a delivery scope waiver, not evidence that Figma has no accessibility requirements or that these modes were tested. Original check retained in previousAccessibilityCheck.

motion.reason: Button Skeleton inherited source reactions established: 1↔0.5, delay 1 ms, 500 ms each direction, cubic (0.2,0,0.4,0.9). Shared runtime reused; 396 exact-curve samples and 48 live Button crops pass for three sizes and both themes. Old nested Loader duration/easing/repeat and full Button motion acceptance remain pending.

integration.reason: Prior package/catalog/independent-consumer checks retained. Current package build and two Medium layout tests passed (32 Hug and 24 Fill combinations); catalog build and one live component UI test passed. Public API unchanged. Full final acceptance still awaits specification, visual and motion; extra accessibility is waived by explicit user decision. Focused Skeleton package suite 3/3, separate exact-curve test 1/1 and native UI suite 2/2 pass; independent consumer build succeeds with additive cornerRadius API. Complete Button integration acceptance still depends on remaining specification/visual/motion work. Final standalone Xcode catalog build and ordinary catalog route verified on 2026-10-15: normal tap increments the count, Skeleton selects source 55915:350412 and disables action; 23 acceptance-registry tests pass. See native-catalog-review-2026-10-15.md.

openIssues: Full paired Figma visual verification for all 147 applicable variants remains pending. Twelve Primary Day pairs and three Skeleton Day pairs measured; Night source pairs, typography and remaining appearances still unaccepted.
System versus legacy SF fonts and resource distribution decision pending; typography is not accepted.

Glass/material backdrop and full Floating state/source shadow verification remain pending. Numeric overflow fade profile and fitting-label opacity verified on 2026-10-13; literal source illustration remains unresolved. Floating Blur conversion corrected against three normal Day pairs; 24 updated native Floating renders. Pixel masking native actions and geometry verified previously; full Sensitive visual/motion acceptance remains pending.
Public icon/smallIcon, independent colors, radius and actual width customization implemented and tested; custom pressed/disabled behavior and all allowed combinations not fully accepted.
Two labels is separate set 51388:47169 and needs its own API and acceptance.

visual.reason: Получены все 21 исходных PNG и 42 Day/Night рендера. Сравнение и исправления продолжаются; системное лицо отличается от старого SF Pro Text. Визуальная приёмка не выполнена.

interaction.reason: All 20 content variants share the same native Button action; source skeleton exposes none. Physical native tests verified tap/cancel/selected/disabled and badge/avatar/skeleton selection, repeated after adding the debug-only motion branch. Motion and actual Reduce Motion are accepted separately under motion; independent consumer runtime remains pending under integration. Scoped renewal after Notification Badge change: package renders, native Card UI and newly installed independent consumer passed; press style and motion inputs did not change. See dependency report. motion.reason: All 20 content variants use the common native ButtonStyle; the source skeleton inherits the accepted TUISkeleton motion. Actual native application verified scale 0.95, restored scale 1, stable layout and neighbor, real Settings Reduce Motion off/on/off, working actions while reduced and resumed motion after foregrounding. Display-timestamp measurements matched 100 ms productive-standard for press/release before and after the setting; independent recorded pixels checked center/neighbor geometry. Diagnostic sampling is 60 Hz; no physical ProMotion measurement is claimed. Scoped renewal after Notification Badge change: package renders, native Card UI and newly installed independent consumer passed; press style and motion inputs did not change. See dependency report.

Scoped renewal after Notification Badge change: package renders, native Card UI and newly installed independent consumer passed; press style and motion inputs did not change. See dependency report. After adding a separate Header Card consumer route, the unchanged Card Medium action/sheet test and two Header Large link-action cases pass; only the consumer entry-point dependency hash is renewed. Scoped renewal 2026-10-08: catalog rebuilt after system-size inheritance and preview-container changes; all three native CardMedium UI tests passed at Large, real system Large/AX1/AX5 regression passed. Production API, motion probe and independent consumer sources did not change.
